From: Olivia Park <olivia@halcyoncloud.com>
To: michael_grant@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood listing inquiry — quick intro + demo?

Hi Michael,

We just tried the self-serve flow from the Redwood listing on the cloud marketplace and spun up a short test workload. We're evaluating inference platforms for a user-facing feature (low-latency chat + embeddings for search). Halcyon Cloud is particularly interested in predictable costs and on-prem/private deployment options.

Can we set up a short call to walk through the platform and a quick demo of latency/cost knobs? I'm hoping to show our engineering manager and a product PM next week.

A few details:
- Traffic: ~300 qps peak during business hours, seasonal spikes
- Data: customer PII, so we need info on private deployment options

Available windows (PST): Tue 11th 10–12, Wed 12th 15–17, Thu 13th after 11am.

Thanks,
Olivia Park
Head of Product
Halcyon Cloud
olivia@halcyoncloud.com

P.S. attached is a simplified architecture doc for context (small file).

Attachment: Halcyon-quick-arch.pdf (application/pdf)
From: michael_grant@redwood.ai
To: Olivia Park <olivia@halcyoncloud.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood listing inquiry — quick intro + demo?

Hi Olivia — great to hear from you and thanks for the details. Welcome!

Irene (cc'd) is our SDR lead and will coordinate a short intro + demo tailored to your latency and private-deploy needs. To get us started, would 30 minutes on Wed 12th at 15:30 PST work? If not, you can pick any slot on my calendar here: https://cal.redwood.ai/michael-grant/30

Agenda (30m):
- 10m: quick intros + architecture context from your side
- 15m: live demo (latency profile, routing, private deployment options)
- 5m: next steps / follow-up items (procurement, RFI)

I've attached a one-pager with quick notes on Dedicated vs Private to help your PM prep.

If you prefer a longer session with an engineer present, let us know and we can extend to 45 minutes.

Best,
Michael Grant
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0134
